name: Tianjin Port Development Holdings Limited
summary: Tianjin Port Development Holdings Limited is an investment holding company, founded in 1968 and based in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong, that operates the Tianjin port in China. Its segments are cargo handling, sales, and other port ancillary services. Cargo handling covers container and non-container cargo, sales supplies fuel and materials, and ancillary services include tugboats, agency and tallying. It is a subsidiary of Tianjin Port Overseas Holding Limited.
